subject: English
stimulus: (a) Five years have passed since ⎯⎯. (b) Hurry up lest ⎯⎯. (c) We love and help one another as if ⎯⎯. (d) We can learn moral values if ⎯⎯. (e) Students stopped playing after ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) Five years have passed since I met Rahim. (b) Hurry up lest you should miss the class. (c) We love and help one another as if we were friends. (d) We can learn moral values if we practice good qualities. (e) Students stopped playing after they had heard the bell.
